parts: Step 1: Convert every line to USD

pipeline_input.name: expense_lines
pipeline_input.description: Month's export: one row per expense line (expense id, employee, merchant, amount, currency, date, category, receipt flag, pre-approval id)

exports.name: converted_lines
exports.description: All expense lines with original fields plus amount_usd (converted at period month-end rate, rounded to cent)

exports.name: duplicate_flags
exports.description: Duplicate findings: expense_id, employee, rule='duplicate', severity='block', detail

exports.name: late_flags
exports.description: Late-submission findings: expense_id, employee, rule='late', severity='review', detail

exports.name: review_queue
exports.description: All findings, one row per finding (expense_id, employee, rule, severity, detail), sorted by employee then expense id

exports.name: auto_approved_employees
exports.description: Employees with no findings and total within limit

exports.name: batch_total_usd
exports.description: Total of the batch in USD

exports.name: employee_totals
exports.description: Per-employee report totals in USD and reimbursable-candidate info

exports.name: controller_decisions
exports.description: Per review item expense_id and decision (approve/reject)

exports.name: report_status
exports.description: Report status, e.g. final or open/escalated
